order.title: Select and order agents
order.description: Select active agents in priority order. Removed agents and their health checks are retained inactive and can be added again.

manage.title: Configure Assist Router

enabled.title: Select enabled agents
enabled.description: Unselected agents retain their settings but will not be called. Keep at least one enabled.

health_agent.title: Choose an agent for health configuration

health_type.title: Availability check type
health_type.description: Without a health check, only HA entity availability is used. Checks run before delegation and are cached.

health.title: Configure availability check
health.description: Read-only HTTP GET; no model loading or inference. LM Studio: enter the full /api/v1/models endpoint. Empty secret fields retain credentials only at the same endpoint. Loaded checks the model and optional instance; Present also accepts an unloaded model.

data.token: Bearer token (empty = retain at same endpoint)
data.password: Basic password (empty = retain at same endpoint)
data.instance_id: Loaded instance ID (empty = any instance of this model)

shared_prompt.title: Shared business instructions
shared_prompt.description: Optional addition to each agent's prompt, not a replacement. Check for conflicting instructions. Changes require a new conversation. Legacy per-agent router additions are preserved until removed below.

data.acknowledge_additive: I understand the additive behavior and new-conversation requirement
data.clear_legacy_additions: Remove legacy per-agent router prompt additions

agent_prompt_text.title: Individual addition
agent_prompt_text.description: {agent}: Optional literal addition after the shared text. Clear to remove. Applies only when shared additions are enabled. Changes to active agents require new conversations.

prompt_review.title: Review agent baseline and implementation
prompt_review.description: Read-only review in the selected mode. Set the neutral baseline in the existing agent dialog; tools remain configured there. Standard approves identity and backend trust scope; Strict additionally verifies source and configuration hashes.

prompt_review_confirm.title: Confirm read-only review

data.confirm: Confirm reviewed result and remaining agent/tool settings

security_mode.title: Security mode
security_mode.description: Standard trusts the approved agent identity and backend, independently of models and routine integration updates. Strict additionally checks exact sources and full configuration. Leaving Strict requires explicit confirmation. Changes while additions are enabled require new conversations.

data.confirm_standard: I confirm switching to Standard without exact source verification

error.invalid_agents: Select distinct conversation entities; the built-in HA agent and routers cannot be targets.
error.no_active_agents: At least one configured agent must remain enabled.
error.invalid_position: Choose an existing agent and a valid position.
error.invalid_url: Use an HTTP(S) URL without URL credentials, query or fragment.
error.invalid_auth: Check authentication credentials. Bearer needs a token; Basic needs a username without a colon. Control characters are not allowed.
error.invalid_model: Enter an exact model key. Instance ID is optional for loaded models; leave it empty for the present-only predicate.
error.invalid_budget: Use finite values within the displayed limits.
error.invalid_status: The expected status must be an integer from 200 to 299.
error.invalid_prompt: Prompts must be text up to 32768 characters; enabled shared text cannot be blank. Review fingerprints must be valid.
error.acknowledge_additive: Confirm additive behavior and conversation boundaries.
error.prompt_review_required: All active agents need a current compatible prompt review. Select an agent and inspect its status.
error.prompt_not_compatible: Review is incompatible. Inspect the status; no agent is modified or bypassed.
error.prompt_changed: The approval basis changed. Inspect the new result before confirming again.
error.confirm_standard_required: Explicitly confirm switching from Strict to Standard.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Assist Router entry is supported.
